notes.title: I played a visual novel about the terror of having a 'casual' boss and a job that wants you to conform to society's expectations—but not the ones involving economic stability
notes.notes: Truer than You is a visual novel about the gig economy. You're hired by a start-up run by a techbro who wears "fun" t-shirts—always a warning sign—to complete vague tasks delivered via phone app. It's sort of like Fiverr only the jobs range from helping someone who might be an artist or might be a terrorist record a threatening video to being someone's plus-one at an event they don't want to attend alone like Jenny Got-No-Friends... Read more.

notes.title: Truer than You is out now!
notes.notes:
[p][b]After five years in development, Truer than You is finally out! We are super happy and proud to present you this game, which we hope will offer both laughter and tears.[/b][/p][p]The world we’re living in is a wild place, always stranger than fiction, but we believe games give players the chance to either escape from reality, or process experiences and challenges - or both at the same time. While developing this game, we have gone through a pandemic, economic crisis, a game industry crash … but we still love making games.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43060804/9cd2a92a58aa30ef71e1f4c77bdb8150476f7e04.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Truer than You, you play as 26-year-old non-binary Rin, who’s just starting their new life in the big city, hired as a gig-working actor to play roles in real life situations. You’ll meet with climate activists, bored housewives, undercover artists - you’re even hired to play the parent of a child. As you navigate through situations, you’ll meet with people who'll become important to you, and will possibly change your life. As time passes, you will also have to face yourself - why did you leave your past behind, to seek out a new life as someone else?[/p][p]If you play the game, please consider leaving a review, that means the world to us! 💖
[/p][p][i][b]Love from Bobbi, Pixie and the Transcenders team[/b][/i][/p]

notes.title: We are sorry - you’ll have to wait a little more!
notes.notes:
[b]Dear players! The release of Truer than You has been delayed due to unforeseen circumstances. We’ve been asked to resubmit our game build to Steam, and therefore we’ll need to delay the release slightly, until we’ve gotten the approval. [/b]

We are very sorry about that, but you can be sure we are working hard to resolve this issue as quickly as possible! We’re looking forward to present you the game soon! Hope you are looking forward to it too 🙂
[i]
Love from the Truer than You team[/i]

notes.title: Truer than You hits Steam May 28!
notes.notes:
[b]Truer than You is about the search for meaning in a conformist society - set in a microcosm where commodified relationships, tech bros, climate activists, bored housewives and undercover artists are all in the mixture.[/b]

The androgyne main character Rin arrives in an unfamiliar city, to start their new position at a secretive company that rents out actors for real life situations. This is the start of a new life, far away from the daily struggles at Rin’s home on a small island. But as Rin gets on with their new endeavours, their past is catching up with them, and they’ll have to deal with who they are and will become.

Truer than You was conceived based upon an article we read about a real company renting out people to play others in social situations. We were still working on Knife Sisters, but thought: This might be the set-up for our next game! 

We have been producing this game since 2020, and it’s been a bumpy ride. The set-up and complexity of it has sometimes been hard to handle. But we are soon at the finishing line - and are extremely proud to present you the game next week!

notes.title: Steam update - Feb 24 2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43060804/2ecde98ed664723edba0b7f9d3d8a069f272c383.png[/img]

[b]Our existential themed visual novel Truer than You is part of Steam Next Fest![/b]
Truer than You is about the search for meaning in a capitalist society - set in a microcosm where commodified relationships, tech bros, climate activists, bored housewives and undercover artists are all in the mixture - portrayed with comic book style graphics and a bubble gum pastel palette. 

For the Next Fest, we have updated the demo - the updates are listed below.

[b]Demo updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] We have added a new intro to the game.
[*] The rating given by clients is now shown in the assignment details in the in-game app, and the mean rating is shown on the app’s starting page.
[*] The whole assignment system is updated, and this demo is the first that uses this new system. We managed to keep the Chinese localization of the demo, while rewriting a lot of the functionality.
[*] The in-game menu has gotten some new icons, and we took out the menu background since it took too much focus.
[/list]

[i][b]If you play the demo, please let us know what you think![/b][/i]

notes.title: Play the Truer than You demo!
notes.notes:
[h3]Truer than You is a game about love, loss and being lost in life. We have been working on it for a long time, and are finally ready to show it to the world!![/h3]

Our aim with this game is to explore the surreal state of reality - offering plenty of opportunities to explore identities, relationships and roles in society - and have a laugh at it as we go!

In an attempt to run away from their past, Rin finds themself in an unknown city, hired as a gig-working actor to play roles in real life situations. But is escaping from yourself really possible - or could playing someone else bring you closer to who you are? 

[b]Please let us know what you think! :)[/b]
